say:1:1541101001:1.text: Herdmaster, may this offering please you.
say:1:1541101001:1.source_cn: 狩猎神大人，请收下贡品。
say:1:1541101001:1.male: Herdmaster, may this offering please you.
say:1:1541101001:1.female: Herdmaster, may this offering please you.

say:2:1541101002:1.text: Here's a necklace, crafted from hawk feathers and boar tusks. There's also a pair of gold earrings, and a goblet made from animal horns...
say:2:1541101002:1.source_cn: 这是羽牙项链，以隼羽和野猪牙制成。还有黄金耳饰，兽角酒杯……
say:2:1541101002:1.male: Here's a necklace, crafted from hawk feathers and boar tusks. There's also a pair of gold earrings, and a goblet made from animal horns...
say:2:1541101002:1.female: Here's a necklace, crafted from hawk feathers and boar tusks. There's also a pair of gold earrings, and a goblet made from animal horns...

say:3:1541101003:1.text: I made all of these myself.
say:3:1541101003:1.source_cn: 这些，都是加拉亲手制作的。
say:3:1541101003:1.male: I made all of these myself.
say:3:1541101003:1.female: I made all of these myself.

choice_prompt:4:1541101003.text: I made all of these myself.
choice_prompt:4:1541101003.source_cn: 这些，都是加拉亲手制作的。
choice_prompt:4:1541101003.male: I made all of these myself.
choice_prompt:4:1541101003.female: I made all of these myself.

say:6:1541101006:1.text: But Modra believes the Herdmaster favors purity.
say:6:1541101006:1.source_cn: 蒙多说，神喜欢纯洁之物。
say:6:1541101006:1.male: But Modra believes the Herdmaster favors purity.
say:6:1541101006:1.female: But Modra believes the Herdmaster favors purity.

say:7:1541101007:1.text: And since I'm the purest among us, she says the task falls to me.
say:7:1541101007:1.source_cn: 加拉是纯洁的祭品。所以，贡品要由加拉来做。
say:7:1541101007:1.male: And since I'm the purest among us, she says the task falls to me.
say:7:1541101007:1.female: And since I'm the purest among us, she says the task falls to me.

say:8:1541101008:1.text: That's the only way to please the Wild Moon.
say:8:1541101008:1.source_cn: 这样，才能取悦雅库伯尔之月。
say:8:1541101008:1.male: That's the only way to please the Wild Moon.
say:8:1541101008:1.female: That's the only way to please the Wild Moon.

say:11:1541101010:1.text: It means the world to me that they please you.
say:11:1541101010:1.source_cn: 能取悦您，是加拉的荣幸。
say:11:1541101010:1.male: It means the world to me that they please you.
say:11:1541101010:1.female: It means the world to me that they please you.

say:12:1541101011:1.text: I can't hunt like the warriors do. I have no hides or blood to offer...
say:12:1541101011:1.source_cn: 加拉不擅长狩猎，不能像战士们那样，为您献上野兽的皮毛和...
say:12:1541101011:1.male: I can't hunt like the warriors do. I have no hides or blood to offer...
say:12:1541101011:1.female: I can't hunt like the warriors do. I have no hides or blood to offer...

say:13:1541101014:1.text: And you don't want a live sacrifice. You wouldn't even claim my life.
say:13:1541101014:1.source_cn: 而且，您不想要活祭，连加拉的生命也没有收下。
say:13:1541101014:1.male: And you don't want a live sacrifice. You wouldn't even claim my life.
say:13:1541101014:1.female: And you don't want a live sacrifice. You wouldn't even claim my life.

say:14:1541101015:1.text: So I keep making more offerings to make up for it.
say:14:1541101015:1.source_cn: 所以，加拉只能以很多贡品为替。
say:14:1541101015:1.male: So I keep making more offerings to make up for it.
say:14:1541101015:1.female: So I keep making more offerings to make up for it.

say:15:1541101016:1.text: Whatever the Herdmaster needs, I will provide it.
say:15:1541101016:1.source_cn: 只要兽群之主需要，加拉会为您敬献一切。
say:15:1541101016:1.male: Whatever the Herdmaster needs, I will provide it.
say:15:1541101016:1.female: Whatever the Herdmaster needs, I will provide it.

say:16:1541101017:1.text: And if the day comes when you no longer need me, then I'll offer my life again.
say:16:1541101017:1.source_cn: 如果有一天，您不再需要加拉的服侍，加拉会再次献上生命。
say:16:1541101017:1.male: And if the day comes when you no longer need me, then I'll offer my life again.
say:16:1541101017:1.female: And if the day comes when you no longer need me, then I'll offer my life again.

say:18:1541101012:1.source_cn: 您是说，野兽的皮毛和鲜血？

say:19:1541101013:1.text: I wish I could offer you those, but hunting's not my forte.
say:19:1541101013:1.source_cn: 加拉不擅长狩猎……无法为您献上这些。
say:19:1541101013:1.male: I wish I could offer you those, but hunting's not my forte.
say:19:1541101013:1.female: I wish I could offer you those, but hunting's not my forte.

choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 我还以为贡品会……更原始

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 我还以为会收到很多贡品

choice:4:1:2.text: You the only one who can make them?
choice:4:1:2.male: You the only one who can make them?
choice:4:1:2.female: You the only one who can make them?
